response.sql: WITH tally AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), 'Missing') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), 'Missing')), shares AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM tally), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_tally, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_s) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
